race.description: Empire Of Japan Standing At Hopetoun Farm Mdn Hcp
race.comment: READY AS BAM (4) had a six-week let-up before finishing a well-beaten second over 800m at Warwick last start. Will take a lot from that run and with luck from a tricky gate can play a role in the outcome. COUP DE CASH (1) is a half-brother to the dual Group 1 winner Pippie, by Capitalist. Recent trial winner who looks to have some of his sibling's ability. SALUKI (11) stalked the pace then tried hard but just missed the placings in a decent effort recently over 800m at Warwick. The last 100m or so is the concern. HAPPYAZIAM (6) is a Brutal filly on debut for the Adam Campton stable. Recent Beaudesert trial winner who can make an immediate impression.
